messages:
olivia: Heads-up — getting a spike of mTLS handshake failures in eu-west after the rotator run.
raj: same here, saw a swarm of KMS decrypt DENY logs for keystore entries around 10:05Z.
marta: quick question — are these ephemeral leaf certs or intermediate chain refreshes? logs show: "decrypt failed: access denied" and "private key missing".
certbot: Rotator run started 2024-09-09T10:05:12Z on rotator-eu cluster-3.
olivia: suspect RBAC change landed yesterday morning for kms keys in eu-west. might have removed decrypt for rotator principal.
sam: tagging @ben_sec and @deploy-bot — can we rollback the RBAC tweak or grant kms:Decrypt to role/rotator-eu immediately?
ben_sec: I'm looking. I reverted the policy fragment that removed decrypt for role/rotator-eu and applied a scoped allow for kms:Decrypt on key/keystore-eu. rolling out now.
olivia: after the revert some proxies recovered, but still seeing ~6% handshake failures across pods.
raj: interestingly, pods that were restarted after the policy fix show normal behavior. seems like existing processes kept a stale state and didn't re-read keystore.
marta: we have a manual endpoint for forcing keystore refresh: POST /admin/keystore/refresh?region=eu-west (internal only).
sam: ran a targeted refresh against pods in cluster-2: curl -X POST 'https://console-internal/api/admin/keystore/refresh?region=eu-west' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' — errors reduced to <1% for that cluster.
deploy-bot: deploy rotator-policy-rollback v1.2 applied to eu-west at 10:14Z.
ben_sec: audit logs show two explicit IAM denies from role/service-proxy-sni between 10:05-10:10Z. Link: https://audit.internal/entries?query=keystore-eu (internal).
marta: proposal: add a fallback in proxy — if KMS decrypt fails during cert fetch, keep serving last-known-good cert for up to 5m and async-trigger refresh. reduces client-facing failures during short RBAC flaps.
raj: +1. also emit metrics: kms_decrypt_errors{region,service} and keystore_refresh_success{region,service} so we can alert earlier.
ben_sec: opened ENGSEC-482: "RBAC policy review for keystore rotator + fallback strategy" — includes checklist items and owner assignments.
olivia: immediate action items recorded: 1) confirm rotator principal has kms:Decrypt in all active regions (owner: sam) 2) add keystore-refresh to ops runbook (owner: marta) 3) create metrics + alert for KMS decrypt errors (owner: sam) 4) implement short cached-cert fallback in proxy logic (owner: infra-next) 5) postmortem if >1% errors persist for 24h.
sam: I'll own #1 and #3, target ETA 2h. will push a canary metric to datadog.
marta: I'll add the runbook steps now and include the curl snippet + escalation matrix.
ben_sec: one more note — some keys are HSM-backed and require an explicit grant mapping; double-check key storage class when validating RBAC.
olivia: good catch, ben_sec. include HSM note in ticket and runbook.
raj: optional: set a temporary canary that routes 10% of traffic to a proxy variant with cached-cert fallback turned on, validate no regressions for 30m before full rollout.
sam: creating canary target for eu-west proxy group A now.
marta: adding postmortem template and first-draft timeline to ENGSEC-482.
olivia: thanks all — monitoring dashboard shows errors trending down. will keep thread open for 2h then close if stable :thumbsup:
sam: canary in place, metrics streaming to dashboard.
ben_sec: leaving a note in audit: RBAC change timestamped 2024-09-08T09:30Z; include that in postmortem.
olivia: closing loop — if any team sees a new spike ping me directly or reopen ticket.
raj: thx everyone, nice quick turnaround.
